name: MM-IFEval
intro: MM-IFEval 是 MM-IFEngine 论文提出的多模态指令遵循评测基准，用于评估多模态模型是否能同时遵循输出组合约束与图像相关感知约束。它由 MM-IFEngine 生成的图像-指令对和人工标注构建，包含 400 道挑战题，其中 300 道为组合级开放题、100 道为感知级问题，并结合规则验证与 judge 模型评分。
org: Fudan University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: MM-IFEngine生成, 人工标注, 冲突复核
metric: 组合级准确率, 感知级准确率, 平均准确率
eval_feature: 组合级约束, 感知级约束, 规则验证, Judge模型
build_method_en: MM-IFEngine Generation, Human Annotation, Conflict Review
eval_feature_en: Compose-level constraints, Perception-level constraints, Rule-based checks, Judge model
intro_en: MM-IFEval is a multimodal instruction-following benchmark introduced by the MM-IFEngine paper. It evaluates whether MLLMs can follow both compose-level output constraints and perception-level constraints tied to images. It is built from MM-IFEngine-generated image-instruction pairs with human annotations, contains 400 challenging questions, and combines rule-based checks with a judge model.
metric_en: Compose-level Accuracy, Perception-level Accuracy, Average Accuracy
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Gather diverse image sources and define 16 tasks"] --> B["Filter few-shot and option-bearing source questions"]
    B --> C["Build six constraint groups and 32 subcategories"]
    C --> D["Use an LLM to integrate constraints and filter contradictions"]
    D --> E["Human-annotate compose-level and perception-level problems"]
    E --> F["Run an extra LLM conflict check"]
    F --> G["Assemble 300 compose-level and 100 perception-level questions"]
    G --> H["Apply rules to 10 verifiable constraint subcategories"]
    H --> I["Use direct and comparative LLM judgment for remaining constraints"]
    I --> J["Report compose, perception, and average accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["汇集多样图像来源并定义16类任务"] --> B["过滤含少样本示例或选项的来源问题"]
    B --> C["建立六类约束与32个子类别"]
    C --> D["用LLM整合约束并过滤矛盾组合"]
    D --> E["人工标注组合级与感知级问题"]
    E --> F["用额外LLM复核约束冲突"]
    F --> G["汇总300道组合级和100道感知级问题"]
    G --> H["对10个可验证约束子类执行规则验证"]
    H --> I["对其余约束执行LLM直接与对比判断"]
    I --> J["报告组合级、感知级和平均准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.07957 Sections 3.2-4.2 and Appendices A-B and E. The diagram preserves diverse image sources, 16 task descriptions, source-question filtering, six constraint groups with 32 subcategories, LLM compatibility checks, human compose/perception annotation, post-annotation conflict mitigation, the exact 300 plus 100 split, rule functions for 10 verifiable subcategories, direct LLM judgment, comparative LLM judgment, and C-level, P-level, and average accuracy.
